source: SOURCEBORN_UNIVERSAL_SEQUENCE_V2_FINAL_REVIEW.md (uploaded Phase-2 review source; exact raw bytes not currently repo-mounted)
ordered_structure_definition: Distinguishable items/states + relationship + declared order relation.
sequence_instance_definition: An ordered structure bound to a declared scope and identity, with at least one traceable transition, derivation, observation, dependency progression, or state/history relation.
causality_rule: Causality must never be inferred from order alone.

A_LOCK: A2 Declared End / Target / Observation Window
A4 Resolution + Causal Horizon + Epistemic Floor
E_DEPENDENCY_PREPARATION: E8 Repair / Obtain / Build / Substitute / Adapt attached Sequences [conditional]
E9 Contract Amendment Sequence [if criterion must change]
F_ALTERNATIVES_RESOLUTION: F7 Decision Record [when a decision-maker exists]
I_VERIFICATION_LEARNING: I4 Repair Candidate [opens new attached Sequence if required]
K_IMMUTABLE_CLOSURE: K3 Return to Requesting Sequence [if any]

critical_repairs.F01: Stage count is not an invariant; count semantic classes instead.
critical_repairs.F02: Ordered Structure is broader than Sequence Instance.
critical_repairs.F03: End-first is Reconstruction mode, not universal live operation.
critical_repairs.F04: Acceptance/Analysis Contract is universal; Requirement is conditional.
critical_repairs.F05: driver_presence is separate from transition_mechanism; natural dynamics may have no driver.
critical_repairs.F06: controller presence/type/control regime are separated from natural mechanism.
critical_repairs.F07: Unaccepted required return blocks successful progression, not necessarily terminal failure closure.
critical_repairs.F08: Pass-3 occurs before immutable closure; later audit is a new Sequence.
critical_repairs.F10: Threshold types are registered/versioned, not ad hoc prose.
critical_repairs.F11: Named loops become predicates that open new Sequence instances.
critical_repairs.F12: Counter-Sequence is cross-cutting, not a late fixed stage.
critical_repairs.F14: Pattern, writer and law formation are normally post-closure derivative Sequences.
critical_repairs.F15: Trace is persistent path consequence; Memory is addressable/encoded for later reuse.
critical_repairs.F16: Independent corroboration is policy/rubric, not a universal two-witness law.
critical_repairs.F17: Requirement reduction requires Contract Amendment / Renegotiation Sequence.
critical_repairs.F19: Event Weight stores necessity, sufficiency, contribution and substitute paths.
critical_repairs.F20: Machine-relevant assertions use first-class CLAIM records.
critical_repairs.F21: Executable transitions use first-class EDGE records.
critical_repairs.F22: Gap, Contradiction, Evidence, Proof-Debt and Open-Sequence ledgers are explicit services.
critical_repairs.F23: Missing/error states use typed null semantics.
critical_repairs.F24: Templates/versions are separated from immutable execution instances.
critical_repairs.F27: Identity continuity changes require evidence-bearing decision packet.
critical_repairs.F28: Compression uses the superset contract and declares information loss.
